utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Good morning to everyone. Apparently the technical problems have been resolved. We have our own transcript. Madam Registrar, would you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. This is case number IT-03-69-T, the Prosecutor versus Jovica Stanisic and Franko Simatovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Thank you, Madam Registrar. We turn into closed session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: this document was sent to the 3rd and 5th administration. Can you explain why?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: The 5th administration was the analytical administration of the RDB. It receives all documents about the people who are being processed through the application of measures or operative coverage. The 3rd administration dealt with extremism. That is why they received all information about paramilitary organisations and their activities in the general territory of that region. That is why the 3rd and the 5th administration were the addressees. The last addressee is actually the institution drafting the document.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: have the 2nd administration sending it to the 1st, 3rd and 5th administrations as well as documentation holdings. Was this document sent to the 3rd administration because of the

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We are in open session, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Thank you, Madam Registrar. I earlier this morning made a mistake. Whereas D264 was not opposed by the Prosecution, I failed to mention it as an exhibit admitted into evidence under seal. D264 is admitted under seal. Mr. Bakrac.

utterances.speaker: MR. BAKRAC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honours, it may seem that I'm just copying the activities of Mr. Jordash. It just happened, so I did say that I completed my examination but there is another document that was not uploaded yet. With your permission, we'll have it uploaded by Monday and I will put just one question in relation to that document.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: That we will allow for that. Mr. Groome, I take it that your request for postponement or bifurcation of the cross-examination will not be bothered by this one final question, apart from that it's cross anyhow.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. May I take it that the request for bifurcation or postponement until Monday is -- do you insist on a decision on that?

utterances.speaker: MR. GROOME
utterances.text: Your Honour, can I ask that no action be taken until Monday. I still haven't gotten through these two binders and I'll raise it with the Chamber on Monday.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes, then we'll not decide before Monday. We adjourn until Monday the 4th of July, quarter past 2.00 in this same Courtroom II.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
